name: Ourselves
source:
The MC is just a regular annoying, arrogant, and careless person in the world. Until one day, he got into a car accident.

Instead of dying, he's being awakened in another body and world that he doesn't recognize at all. A body that has already well-shaped like a girl. A world that forces him to become a woman because of his new look.

His memories have been wiped out. He doesn't remember anything about himself and his past life.

Will he get all of his memories, past, and life back? Can he still be a man? MC's fate is in the player's decision. 

[From [url=https://testingmood.itch.io/ourselves]Itch.io[/url]]
